place.name: Area codes 876 and 658
place.description: Area codes 876 and 658 are telephone area codes in the North American Numbering Plan (NANP) for Jamaica. Having telephone service to the United States as early as 1936, it was not until 1962 that Jamaica had a high-capacity link for dial service to the US network, which was operated as part of the NANP numbering plan area 809.
